features: VERSITALE BAKING: OvenStuff Nonstick 6-cup Muffin Cap Baking Pan is the ideal pan to make a variety of baked goods. Cavity measures 4-inch in diameter making this pan ideal for perfectly shaped whoopie pies, cookies, mini cakes, appetizers and more.

description: OvenStuff Nonstick 6-cup Muffin Cap Baking Pan is the ideal pan to make a variety of baked goods. Cavity measures 4-inch in diameter making this pan ideal for perfectly shaped whoopie pies, cookies, mini cakes, appetizers and more. Pan features a proprietary DuraGlide PLUS reinforced nonstick finish that allow baked goods to release effortlessly without the need for grease, cooking sprays, or paper liners. The durable steel heats evenly with no hotspots so food bakes to a beautiful golden finish edge to edge. Hand wash and towel dry only. OvenStuff Nonstick 6-cup Muffin Cap Baking Pan is made in the USA. Cavity measures 4-inch in diameter. External dimensions are 13.5 X 11.4 X 0.2-inch.
